acceptance: Crate aipo-sema implemented with lexical scope hierarchy and symbol table.
Name resolution supporting global items, local variables, parameters, and shadowing rules.
Detection of redeclarations within the same lexical scope (AIPO_SEM_REDECLARED_IN_SCOPE).
Detection of mutations to read-only bindings (let / immutable params) (AIPO_SEM_READONLY_MUTATION).
Arity validation for known function calls with required vs optional parameters (AIPO_SEM_ARITY_MISMATCH).
Structural interface satisfaction validation for satisfy declarations.
Exhaustive pass/fail tests verifying diagnostic emissions and semantic facts.
Zero unsafe code (unsafe_code = 'forbid') and quality gates clean.
constraints: No invention: unresolved questions remain ADPs.
Compiler never panics; all semantic violations emit structured diagnostics.

evidence.description: cargo test -p aipo-sema passed with 8 automated tests covering scope resolution, redeclaration checks, immutable let/param mutation prevention, function call arity checks, and interface satisfaction verification

non_goals: Core IR generation or bytecode emission (reserved for S6).
objective: Implement aipo-sema for lexical resolution, mutability checking, and contract verification
title: Semantic Analysis: Scopes, mutability paths, signature contracts, and interface conformance
